subject: Dashboard won't load after latest update
text: Since this morning's update, the analytics dashboard just spins and never loads. I've tried three different browsers and cleared my cache. Our whole team relies on this for the morning standup and we're flying blind right now.
name: Priya Nandakumar

subject: Duplicate charge on my account
text: I was charged $249 twice on the 12th for my monthly subscription. I need this refunded immediately - I've already disputed one of the charges with my bank and I'd rather resolve it directly with you first.
name: Marcus Whitfield

subject: How do I add teammates to my workspace?
text: New to the platform - trying to figure out how to invite three coworkers to my workspace so we can collaborate on the same project. Couldn't find this in the settings menu.
name: Devon Yates

subject: Locked out after password reset
text: I reset my password an hour ago and now I can't log in at all - it just says 'invalid credentials' no matter what I try. I have a client presentation in 20 minutes and need access to my files.
name: Anita Kowalczyk

subject: Unbelievable that this keeps happening
text: This is the THIRD time this quarter your export feature has corrupted my data. I've lost hours of work. If this isn't fixed by end of day I'm cancelling our enterprise contract and telling everyone I know not to use this product.
name: Robert Chen

subject: Question about annual vs monthly billing
text: Can you tell me the price difference between paying monthly versus switching to an annual plan? Just trying to budget for next year before we renew.
name: Sofia Alvarado

subject: Feature request: dark mode
text: Would love to see a dark mode option added to the app - staring at the bright white interface for 8 hours a day is rough on the eyes. Not urgent, just a nice-to-have.
name: Jamal Okafor

subject: API returning 500 errors intermittently
text: Our integration has started throwing 500 errors on roughly 1 in 10 calls to the /reports endpoint over the last two days. Nothing changed on our end. Happy to share request IDs and logs if that helps track it down.
name: Elena Sokolova

subject: Need to speak with legal about our data processing agreement
text: Our compliance team flagged a clause in the DPA that needs to be reviewed before we can renew. Please connect me with someone who can discuss contract terms directly.
name: Thomas Reyes

subject: Can't remember how to export to CSV
text: I know I've done this before but I can't find the export button anywhere on the reports page. Could you point me in the right direction?
name: Grace Lindqvist

subject: Account suspended without warning
text: I logged in this morning and got a message saying my account is suspended pending review. No email, no explanation. I have payroll to run today and this is causing a real problem for my team.
name: Deborah Osei

subject: Mobile app crashes on photo upload
text: Every time I try to attach a photo to a ticket from the mobile app it crashes immediately. Works fine on desktop. Running the latest iOS version on an iPhone 15.
name: Kenji Watanabe

subject: Requesting refund for unused seats
text: We downsized last month and are now only using 8 of the 20 seats we're paying for. I'd like to discuss a partial refund or credit for the unused licenses going forward.
name: Natalie Fournier

subject: How to set up SSO with Okta
text: Our IT team wants to roll out single sign-on through Okta for all employees using the platform. Is there documentation on how to configure this, or do we need to work with someone on your side?
name: Victor Ibrahim

subject: Two-factor authentication codes never arrive
text: I've tried logging in five times today and the SMS verification code never shows up. Checked spam, checked my carrier, nothing. I'm completely locked out of an account I need for work.
name: Lauren Petrova

subject: Webhook signature verification failing after rotating our secret
text: We rotated our webhook signing secret last week and now every incoming webhook fails our HMAC signature check, even though we updated the secret on both sides. Is there a grace period where old and new secrets are both valid, or a specific header format change we should be aware of?
name: Yusuf Demir
note: Highly specific integration/webhook detail not covered by any KB article - good test of whether the Specialist admits it doesn't know rather than confidently guessing.

subject: Currency conversion discrepancy between our two regional accounts
text: We run separate workspaces for our EU and US entities. The EU workspace was invoiced in EUR but the converted USD amount on our internal books doesn't match either the invoice date or payment date exchange rate - it's off by about 4%. Can you tell me exactly which rate and timestamp your billing system uses for conversion?
name: Camille Dubosc
note: No KB article covers FX conversion methodology - tests whether the agent escalates instead of fabricating a plausible-sounding but wrong exchange-rate policy.

subject: Mapping custom fields through our Zapier integration
text: Trying to set up a Zap that maps three custom fields we created (region, deal_stage, renewal_date) into a new record, but two of the three fields don't show up as options in Zapier's field picker. Is there a limit on which custom field types are exposed to Zapier?
name: Bianca Oduya
note: Third-party integration detail (Zapier field exposure) not documented in the KB - a plausible real-world gap rather than a truly obscure edge case.

subject: Need to merge two duplicate accounts into one
text: I accidentally signed up twice with slightly different emails years ago and now have two separate accounts with data split between them. Is there a way to merge them into a single account, keeping all the history from both?
name: Owen Fitzgerald
note: Account merging is an unusual, irreversible operation with no self-service KB article - tests whether the agent correctly refuses to improvise a workaround and escalates instead.

subject: Which data center is our data physically stored in?
text: For an upcoming data residency review, our security team needs to confirm the physical region/data center where our workspace's data is stored at rest, and whether backups ever leave that region.
name: Ingrid Sæther
note: Data residency specifics aren't in the KB (only general DPA article exists) - tests whether the agent distinguishes 'related KB article exists' from 'KB article actually answers this' rather than citing KB015 as if it resolves the question.
